title: 8 Signs a Godly Man Is Praying Like a Future Husband
caption:
8 signs a godly man is praying like a future husband, before he's even found her.

He stops praying "send her" and starts praying "make me ready." He asks God to finish things in him first. He thanks God for the delay, not just the eventual answer.

Seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well (Matthew 6:33). A wife won't fix what only God can. A man content today is the one worth waiting for.

theme: He chases God, not a wife.
